name: SUNO RSO Tincture – 200MG
description: A sublingual tincture made with full-spectrum Rick Simpson Oil (RSO), offering therapeutic benefits from a wide range of cannabinoids, terpenes, and flavonoids. Each 30mL bottle contains 200mg THC plus minor cannabinoids, with 6.66mg THC per 1mL serving. Metered droppers ensure accurate dosing every time. Vegan. Nut-free. Free of dyes, sugar, and gluten. Clinically Relevant Cannabis. Clinically Relevant Results.
